Includes temperature, salinity, oocyte size, lipid and protein content, elemental ratios, and associated latitude/longitude for each sample.

metadata.name: MITAPI 2015‑2010 Difference NetCDF Dataset
metadata.description: A collection of NetCDF files containing the spatial differences of various MITAPI variables (agriculture, energy, industry, precipitation, production, etc.) between the years 2010 and 2015. Each file is provided at a 1°×1° grid resolution and covers the same temporal period.

metadata.name: Elwha River Delta sensor measurements
metadata.description: Dataset of HRMS and VRMS sensor readings, elevation, and status collected at multiple points along the Elwha River Delta on March 20, 2011.

metadata.name: Elwha River Delta Sensor Measurements
metadata.description: Time‑series sensor data collected along the Elwha River Delta, including geographic coordinates (latitude, longitude, elevation), timestamps, horizontal and vertical RMS values, status, and descriptive identifiers for each measurement.

metadata.name: Permafrost and Ground Temperature Data (2000‑2017)
metadata.description: Dataset comprising mean annual ground temperature (MAGTM), its standard deviation (MAGTSTD), and permafrost probability fraction (PERPROB) for the period 2000‑2017. The data are provided as ZIP archives and include a thumbnail image.

metadata.name: Archive Files Index for El Bizri et al. 2019
metadata.description: Table listing archived interview and hunting register files related to pregnancy diagnoses and hunting records, including file names, formats, sizes, and URLs.

metadata.name: Laboratory measurements of Magallana hongkongensis (mollusk) in Zhanjiang
metadata.description: A dataset of laboratory measurements for the oyster species Magallana hongkongensis, including various treatment groups and physicochemical parameters (e.g., stiffness, hardness, density, pH, temperature, salinity, carbonate chemistry) collected at a single site in Zhanjiang (latitude 21.33333, longitude 110.66667) on 2016-06-01.

metadata.name: Bohm et al. 2020 EC and Noah-MP model datasets for Katharinentalerhof, Pforzheim
metadata.description: A collection of metadata entries for various data files (EC measurements, plant performance data, weather data, and Noah-MP model outputs) associated with the Katharinentalerhof site in Pforzheim, Germany. Includes file names, formats, sizes, URLs, event location, and geographic coordinates.

metadata.name: Macapule Lagoon fish biometric data
metadata.description: A collection of fish biometric measurements (length, mass, organ weights, condition indices, and biochemical parameters) collected from the Macapule Lagoon site in Baja California Sur, Mexico. The dataset includes records from multiple seasons and years (2013‑2015) with associated date, season, and geographic coordinates.

metadata.name: Macapule Lagoon Water Quality Data
metadata.description: Measurements of temperature, salinity, dissolved oxygen, pH, ammonia, nitrate, and phosphate collected at Macapule Lagoon (latitude 25.35, longitude -108.5) across multiple zones and dates between December 2013 and June 2015.

metadata.name: Mytilus galloprovincialis laboratory experiment dataset
metadata.description: Laboratory measurements of physiological and chemical parameters (e.g., temperature, pH, salinity, DIC, CO₂, carbonate species, Omega) for the mussel Mytilus galloprovincialis under control and high CO₂ treatments across various developmental stages and time points. Includes replicate observations of cell stage, percentage metrics, and associated metadata such as treatment, time (hours), and experimental event.

metadata.name: Marine mammal sightings 2014
metadata.description: A dataset of whale and dolphin sightings recorded in 2014, including date and time, geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude), species identification, certainty level, and event identifier.

metadata.name: Balloon ascent measurements 2018-08-18
metadata.description: Time‑series of atmospheric observations collected during a balloon flight on 2018‑08‑18. Each record includes UTC date/time, geographic position (longitude, latitude), altitude, pressure, temperature, relative humidity, wind direction (dd) and wind speed (ff).

metadata.name: Geochemical core sample measurements (370BVWR2)
metadata.description: Dataset of alkane (Alk peak area) and diol (Diols peak area) measurements from sediment core samples collected at a single site (latitude 32.366667, longitude 134.966333, elevation -4776 m) on 2016‑09‑17. Each row includes sample identifiers, depth intervals, and associated geochemical peak areas.

metadata.name: UPC Sensor Files Metadata
metadata.description: A table of binary sensor output files (ZIP archives) with their MIME type, size, associated event, geographic location (latitude, longitude, elevation) and acquisition date.

metadata.name: Birkeland Cruise Video Dataset
metadata.description: A collection of video event records from the Birkeland cruise, including file names, sizes, hashes, geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude), and timestamps for each recorded event.

metadata.name: Aerosol size distribution and chemical composition measurements (PS106 track)
metadata.description: The dataset contains aerosol sampling data collected along the PS106 flight track. Each record includes the sampling stage, aerosol size range, sampling date and time, geographic coordinates (two locations per sample), measurement height, and concentrations of various chemical species (Cl‑, NO₃⁻, SO₄²⁻, C₂O₄²⁻, NO₂⁻, Br⁻, F⁻, MSA, PO₄³⁻, Na⁺, NH₄⁺, K⁺, Mg²⁺). Measurements span multiple dates in May–July 2017 across a latitudinal range from ~55° N to ~84° N and longitudinal range from ~3° E to ~33° E.

metadata.name: Stordalen_2 sediment core age data
metadata.description: A CSV dataset containing depth, sample thickness, radiocarbon ages, uncertainties, material types, laboratory labels, and geographic coordinates for the Stordalen_2 sediment core. The data records ages ranging from the early 20th century to the early 21st century for a single core location.

metadata.name: Mackenzie River Isotope Measurements 2019
metadata.description: Isotopic composition (δ18O, δD) and water depth measurements collected at multiple stations along the Mackenzie River during several expeditions in 2019. Each record includes event ID, expedition number, latitude, longitude, date/time, station name, water depth, and isotope values.

metadata.name: Nuna WP4 Mackenzie 2019‑2020 Fluorescence Dataset
metadata.description: Point‑based measurements of fluorescence dissolved organic matter (FDOM) and related optical parameters collected at multiple stations during several expeditions (Expedition 1‑4) in the Mackenzie River/Arctic region between April 2019 and September 2020.

metadata.name: WDC06A Ice Core Isotope Measurements
metadata.description: A collection of ice core measurements from the WDC06A site, including depth, gas age, δ18O, Δ36 isotopic values, and associated metadata such as latitude, longitude, elevation, and the sampling date.

metadata.name: German collector trial pre-impact dataset
metadata.description: Chemical element concentration measurements from sediment cores collected at station SO268_043MUC (Latitude 11.93056667, Longitude -117.0224333) during a pre‑impact German collector trial. Each row includes depth, elemental concentrations (e.g., Al, Ba, Ca, Fe, etc.), elevation, and the acquisition timestamp.

metadata.name: Sediment core geochemical profile SO268_074MUC
metadata.description: A CSV file containing geochemical measurements (trace element concentrations and their relative errors) from a sediment core (Core 18) collected at station SO268_074MUC in the Belgian collector trial pre‑impact. Each row corresponds to a different depth interval with associated latitude, longitude, elevation and timestamp.

metadata.name: Sylt trawl habitat observations
metadata.description: Dataset of benthic trawl samples collected around Sylt, Germany. Each record includes geographic coordinates (two sets), bathymetric depth, date and time of sampling, habitat type, fish total length (S. scombrus), salinity, temperature, and event identifier.

metadata.name: ROV Quicklook Images for Survey PS122/5_61-35 (2020-09-08)
metadata.description: A list of ROV quicklook image files generated during survey PS122/5_61-35 on 2020-09-08, including the associated date, survey ID, event name, geographic coordinates (latitude 88.675993, longitude 112.324519) and elevation (-4291.4 m).

metadata.name: Geographic Topographic Data Collection
metadata.description: A list of file references to geographic and topographic data archives, including zip files for regions such as Big Skidder, Black Hills, Blue Hills, Cougar Mountain, Devils Mountain, Dow Mountain, Fidalgo Island, Lopez Island, San Juan, and an Excel file containing raw topographic high data.

metadata.name: Pacific Mn nodule samples 1970
metadata.description: Dataset of manganese (Mn) nodule samples collected in the Pacific region in 1970, including geographic coordinates, elevation, chemical composition (Mn, Fe, Ni, Co, Cu), sample type, descriptive notes, and collection date.

metadata.name: Preserved specimen dataset from PS80, PS92, PS106, and PS122 expeditions
metadata.description: A collection of preserved marine specimens collected during several research expeditions (PS80, PS92, PS106, PS122). For each specimen the dataset provides expedition identifiers, sample IDs, collection date, gear type, water depth, geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude), morphological measurements (e.g., B. saida TL, SL, weight, sex, condition indices), comments, and elevation of the sampling site.

metadata.name: Lake Constance Total Phosphorus Concentration (1951-2010)
metadata.description: Annual measurements of total phosphorus (TP) concentrations in Lake Constance at the Fischbach-Uttwil site. The dataset includes summer averages for the upper 20 m of the water column (July‑September) from 1967 to 2010 and winter mixing period concentrations for the full water column from 1951 to 1966. Each record provides the year, depth information, TP value, a description of the sampling period, and the geographic coordinates of the sampling location.

metadata.name: Mn nodule geochemical dataset PLDS04MV-109BX
metadata.description: Geochemical composition measurements of manganese nodules collected at site PLDS04MV-109BX in the Pacific Ocean, including latitude, longitude, elevation, sample type, and elemental concentrations, recorded on 1976-08-27.

metadata.name: M186_50-1GC sediment chemistry dataset
metadata.description: Measurements of sediment chemical concentrations (including nitrate, nitrite, ammonium, phosphate, chloride, sulfate, bromide, and various metals) collected at multiple depths for station M186_50-1GC, with associated latitude, longitude, elevation, and sampling date.

metadata.name: Sediment chemistry profile for station M186_54-1 (2022‑12‑16)
metadata.description: Measurements of sediment chemical composition (NO3, NO2, NH4, PO4, Cl, SO4, Br, B, Mn, Ca, Fe, Na, Mg, Sr, Si, Ba, Li, K) at multiple depths for station M186_54-1, recorded at a single location (38.74553 °N, 28.56587 °W) on 16 December 2022.

metadata.name: Limacina helicina laboratory incubation dataset 2019
metadata.description: Measurements of the marine pteropod Limacina helicina collected in laboratory incubations in September 2019. The dataset includes physical‑chemical parameters such as temperature, salinity, dissolved oxygen, DIC, total alkalinity, pH, and carbonate system variables for different sample types (control, incubation, initial collection) and treatment conditions.

metadata.name: Baltic Sea pCO2 climatology and trend
metadata.description: Dataset containing climatological averages and long‑term trends of surface water partial pressure of CO₂ (pCO₂) in the Baltic Sea.

metadata.name: Marine Salp and Pyrosome Sample Dataset
metadata.description: A compilation of marine biological samples collected during multiple research expeditions (2004‑2008) using bongo nets and other gear. The data include species identifiers (salps, pyrosomes, tunicates), sample measurements (size, mass, elemental composition), sampling depth, geographic coordinates, date/time, vessel and station information for locations in the Northeast Pacific, Southern Ocean and New Zealand's Chatham Rise.

metadata.name: Cape Blossom 2021-06-25 7 cm aerial imagery
metadata.description: A collection of aerial remote‑sensing products captured over Cape Blossom, Alaska on 25 June 2021 at a 7 cm ground‑sample distance. Includes RGB and CIR preview PNGs, orthophoto GeoTIFF, DSM GeoTIFF, hillshade, point‑cloud tiles, tile footprint GeoJSON and processing information.

metadata.name: Ice Core Sample Measurements
metadata.description: Dataset of ice and snow core samples collected at a single location on 2004-12-29, including depth, density, and descriptive depth information for each sample.

metadata.name: Environmental Monitoring Data Collection
metadata.description: A collection of environmental measurement files covering physico‑chemical parameters, particulate matter composition, temperature records, and hydrological discharge data, each accompanied by a metadata description file.

metadata.name: Porites coral geochemical measurements from TIAREI-A1 (2008)
metadata.description: Dataset of Sr/Ca, Mg/Ca, δ18O and δ13C measurements from a Porites sp. coral core (event TIAREI-A1) collected at latitude -17.506944 and longitude -149.4225 (elevation -15 m) on 2008-07-01. Each row includes an age estimate (both decimal year and calendar year) and the corresponding geochemical values.

metadata.name: Porites coral geochemical data (Sr/Ca, Mg/Ca, δ18O, δ13C) - TIAREI-3B
metadata.description: A time‑series of Porites coral geochemical measurements (Sr/Ca, Mg/Ca, δ18O, δ13C) with associated age, event label, and site information (latitude, longitude, elevation) collected on 2008‑07‑01 at the TIAREI‑3B location.

metadata.name: Flade Isblink Ice Cap Cryoconite Sample Data
metadata.description: Dataset of cryoconite and river sediment samples collected on the Flade Isblink ice cap in Greenland. Each record includes sample ID, geographic coordinates, collection date/time, depth, sample type, and a suite of measured radionuclide concentrations and related parameters.

metadata.name: Santiurde Section Soil Profile Measurements
metadata.description: A collection of soil profile measurements from the Santiurde section, including sample identifiers, thickness, mineral ratios, stratigraphic height, and concentrations of quartz, clay, calcium, gypsum, dolomite, and pyrite. Each record is associated with a single geographic point (latitude 43.0685608, longitude -4.0878295) and elevation of 730 m. The dataset does not contain explicit date/time information.

metadata.name: Snow and ice density profiles from DML21/22 Antarctic field campaign
metadata.description: Point measurements of snow/ice depth intervals and density collected at multiple Antarctic sites (DML21/22) during December 2021 and January 2022. Each record includes the event identifier, geographic coordinates (latitude, longitude), depth of the sampled layer, timestamps, and the measured snow density (kg m⁻³).

metadata.name: Kiwada Kazusa Chiba River Sediment Samples
metadata.description: A collection of sediment sample measurements from the Ono and Yuki River sections in the Kazusa region of Chiba, Japan. Includes sample identifiers, stratigraphic section, age (years BP), SR values, reference source, and geographic coordinates for each sample.

metadata.name: Paleomagnetic Virtual Geomagnetic Pole measurements
metadata.description: A collection of paleomagnetic observations from sediment cores, providing depth, magnetic declination, inclination, Kappa values, VGP (Virtual Geomagnetic Pole) latitude and longitude, and associated uncertainties for each sample.

metadata.name: Uelzen Germany satellite imagery and indices 1984‑2023
metadata.description: A collection of GeoTIFF files and associated shapefiles for the Uelzen area in Germany, containing 6‑band colour composites, NDVI (vegetation index) and NirV (metabolism index) products for three‑month periods (May‑July and August‑October) from 1984 to 2023, together with yearly vector zone files.

metadata.name: Aalen Germany multi-year remote sensing dataset
metadata.description: A collection of GeoTIFF raster files (6‑band colour composites, NDVI vegetation index, and NIRV metabolism index) and accompanying yearly shapefiles for the city of Aalen, Germany, covering the period 1984‑2023. Each raster represents a three‑month season (May‑July or August‑October) and is provided per year.

metadata.name: Soil geochemistry measurements from NEP sites
metadata.description: A dataset of soil sample analyses collected at two NEP locations in Italy, including latitude, longitude, depth, elemental concentrations (U, Th, K, De), total soil density, age dating results, elevation, and the sampling date and time.

metadata.name: Borneo archaeological radiocarbon dataset
metadata.description: A compilation of radiocarbon and other dating results for archaeological sites across Malaysia and Indonesia (Borneo). Includes uncalibrated and calibrated ages, standard deviations, calibration ranges, and literature references for each sample.

metadata.name: Geochemical composition dataset
metadata.description: Dataset of oxide weight percentages (SiO2, TiO2, Al2O3, Fe2O3, MnO, MgO, CaO, Na2O, K2O, P2O5) for rock samples, including sample identifiers, geographic coordinates, elevation, and acquisition date/time.

metadata.name: Pleistocene and Pliocene sediment core geochemistry dataset
metadata.description: Geochemical and isotopic measurements (e.g., Al, Ca, Fe, K, Mn, Na, P, Mo, U, TOC, δ15N, δ13C, δ98Mo) from sediment cores collected at site 112‑680A (latitude -11.065, longitude -78.07783) during a single sampling event on 5 November 1986. The dataset includes depth, core identifiers, and a range of elemental ratios for both Pleistocene and Pliocene intervals.

metadata.name: Geophysical borehole measurements from MSM44_362-1 site
metadata.description: A collection of borehole measurements including depth, core diameter deviation, P‑wave travel time, P‑wave velocity (Vp‑a), and related geophysical parameters recorded at a single location (75.97917 °N, ‑66.04717 °W) on 12 July 2015. The dataset contains multiple depth sections for different core sections and event identifiers.

metadata.name: Sucha Woda Flood Boulder Diameter Survey
metadata.description: Measurements of boulder diameters, number of trunks, elevation and geographic coordinates for multiple sites affected by the Sucha Woda flood event on 24 July 2018.

metadata.name: ANT 1997/98 EMR Radar Profile Dataset
metadata.description: Collection of EMR radar profile files from the Antarctic 1997/98 season, including netCDF data, GIS KML files, and associated images for each profile ID.

metadata.name: Laboratory experiment zooplankton and phytoplankton pulsation dataset
metadata.description: Measurements of X. umbellata pulsation (unitless) recorded in twelve experimental tanks (T1‑T12) under different treatments (Zooplankton, Control, DOC, Phytoplankton) at several time points (DOE = 0, 7, 14, 21, 28). The data are from a controlled laboratory experiment.

metadata.name: Sediment core isotopic dataset M78/1_181-3
metadata.description: A marine sediment core dataset containing depth (cm), age (ka), Uvigerina spp. δ13C and δ18O isotopic measurements, event identifiers, and site metadata (latitude, longitude, elevation, and collection timestamp). All samples are from a single location (29.0° N, 88.33° W) collected on 2009‑03‑04.

metadata.name: Geochemical Sample Profiles for Event 386-M0095B
metadata.description: Dataset of sediment sample measurements collected during event 386-M0095B on 2021-05-30. Each row provides depth, mineral composition (e.g., quartz, calcite, etc.), sample label, IGSN, and associated metadata such as latitude (36.89168333), longitude (143.4078833), elevation (-7697.0 m), and the collection date.

metadata.name: Sediment Geochemical Measurements with Spatial Coordinates
metadata.description: A collection of sediment geochemistry observations including depth, total organic carbon (TOC), pH, CaCO3, grain‑size fractions, and trace element concentrations, recorded at specific latitude/longitude points for two sampling events (BH‑II and BH‑rec) on 2018‑07‑22 and 2019‑08‑12.

metadata.name: 383-U1539 sediment core measurements
metadata.description: Dataset of sediment core samples from site 383-U1539, containing depth, age, sea surface temperature (SST) and its standard deviation, latitude, longitude, elevation and the date/time of each measurement. The data represent multiple horizons within the cores and are intended for paleoceanographic and geological analyses.

metadata.name: Paleo core geochemical measurements
metadata.description: A collection of geochemical and isotopic measurements (e.g., TOC, TIC, δ13C, δ15N, grain size fractions, age, and other parameters) from multiple sediment cores (NPAL04, NPAL05, NPAL07, NPAL08, NPAL12, NPAL14, NPAL15, NPAL17, NPAL19, AeN_Q1_P1_BC1) with associated depth, latitude, longitude, and sampling date information.

metadata.name: Geochemical profile GeoB16310-2
metadata.description: Dataset of sediment geochemical measurements including depth, total organic carbon (TOC), total inorganic carbon (TIC), event identifier, latitude, longitude, elevation, and timestamp for a single sampling location.

metadata.name: Sediment TOC and TIC measurements at GeoB16310-3
metadata.description: Measurements of depth, total organic carbon (TOC), total inorganic carbon (TIC), event identifier, latitude, longitude, elevation, and timestamp for a single sediment core (GeoB16310-3).

metadata.name: GeoB16320-2 sediment geochemistry profile
metadata.description: Measurements of sediment depth, total organic carbon (TOC), total inorganic carbon (TIC), and associated metadata (event ID, latitude, longitude, elevation, and timestamp) for the GeoB16320-2 site.

metadata.name: AMK75-6150 diatom and environmental dataset
metadata.description: A dataset of sediment core measurements from the AMK75-6150 site, including depth, age, diatom species abundances, and associated environmental variables, with geographic coordinates (latitude 74.779983, longitude 8.435083) and elevation for each sample.

metadata.name: MOSAiC Ice Core Chemical Measurements
metadata.description: Measurements of ice core samples collected during the MOSAiC expedition, including depth intervals, chlorophyll‑a, phaeophytin, elevation and associated metadata such as campaign, activity, event, date, latitude and longitude for each core segment.

metadata.name: Sediment depth profile of 210Pb and 137Cs at LSMo22-1 site
metadata.description: Measurements of 210Pb, 137Cs and related radionuclide concentrations taken at multiple sediment depths for a single core (event LSMo22-1) at latitude 21.365278, longitude -104.568333 on 2022-04-08.

metadata.name: Sediment 210Pb Profile
metadata.description: Measurements of 210Pb activity, its supported and unsupported fractions, and associated standard deviations at multiple sediment depth intervals for a single site (latitude 21.277661, longitude -104.690167) collected on 2022-04-08.

metadata.name: LTp22-1 sediment core geochemical profile
metadata.description: A geochemical dataset of a single sediment core (LTp22-1) containing depth, age, and elemental concentration measurements (e.g., Si, K, Ca, Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Fe, Ni, Cu, Zn, Ge, Sr, Zr, Cd, Ce, Ta) along with the sampling location (latitude 21.277661, longitude -104.690167, elevation 1430 m) and the collection date (2022‑04‑08).

metadata.name: Macoma balthica shell length and frequency - Rönnebank June 2023
metadata.description: Dataset of Macoma balthica shell length (mm) and frequency counts collected during expedition EMB320 at Rönnebank in the Baltic Sea in June 2023, covering both a Marine Protected Area and a Reference area.

metadata.name: Lanaittu core sample dataset
metadata.description: A dataset of mineralogical and petrological measurements from core samples collected at the Lanaittu site, including depth, mineral abundances, visual observations, and geographic coordinates for each sample recorded on 1994-01-01.
